status.description: Authored. `accepted` requires: non-empty owner; >=1 evidence with sha256 (file refs resolve and hash-match); >=1 artifact checked in order -- ready != false, parseable validated_at, non-empty checks from the closed opens/exports/tokens-resolve vocabulary, validator_version 1, path resolves as a regular file and hash-matches, validated_at not older than the file mtime (an mtime-only touch is stale), and a matching passing validation record under .tasteful/validations/ (same sha256/validator_version/check-name set, all verdicts pass, validated_at not older than the file mtime); a passing gate_ref whose stored gate carries an approval_digest resolving to the consumed gate_accept record for that gate content; and a consumed non-owner (canonical identity) decision_accept approval whose content_hash = computeAuthoredContentHash(decision). Submitting accepted with a fresh validation + approval is also the re-review transition from stale/needs_review/invalidated to current.

review_state.description: DERIVED (read-only): written by closure, drift, and the accepted re-review transition. Authored decision_upsert input carrying this field is rejected with E_SCHEMA; ordinary updates preserve the stored value. artifact_validate OK does not clear it.

owner.description: Authored and stored verbatim: empty or leading/trailing whitespace is E_SCHEMA (never silently trimmed). Owner/approver comparison uses canonicalIdentity: NFKC + trim; email-shaped local@domain lowercases the domain only (local-part case preserved); other ids lowercase the whole value; empty canonical identity rejected.

validated_at.description: ISO timestamp of the passing validation. Acceptance rejects (E_ACCEPT_NO_ARTIFACT) in order: ready:false; missing/unparseable validated_at; empty checks; an unsupported check label; validator_version != 1; path/regular-file/hash mismatch; validated_at older than the artifact mtime (an mtime-only touch is stale even with unchanged bytes/hash); no matching passing validation record.

checks.description: Closed vocabulary: opens, exports, tokens-resolve. exports/tokens-resolve apply only to .figcraft artifacts. Acceptance requires a non-empty list; unknown or failed/prefixed labels (fail, opens:failed) are rejected as unsupported.

ready.description: Acceptance rejects ready:false first, before filesystem work; a bare ready:true is never sufficient without hash/freshness checks and a matching passing validation record.

decision_hash.description: DERIVED (read-only): sha256 over canonical authored content excluding review_state/decision_hash. Recomputed by the system writer and verified on every read (E_HASH_MISMATCH on tamper). Authored input carrying this field is rejected with E_SCHEMA.
